title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a floor-force bathroom-scale experiment sheet
body:
## Problem
The worked examples suggest standing on a scale in a lift, but there is no step-by-step sheet for it.

## Context
Model versus measurement is part of every session (QUALITY.md, item 7).

## Expected outcome
A one-page activity sheet with a table to fill in and the expected readings for a = 0.5 and 1 m/s^2.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Table and instructions included
- [ ] Safety note: do the experiment only in lifts you are allowed to use

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: feed-forward for the force lag
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet. The shipped controller adds jerk beyond the planned limit.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Session 3 reports a simulated peak jerk of 2.13 m/s^3 for a planned 1.5.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add Session 5: a plan search inside the comfort box
body:
## Problem
Session 3 uses one hand-picked plan; the fastest comfortable plan has not been searched for.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5.

## Expected outcome
A lesson and app that search acceleration, jerk and speed limits automatically and report the best travel time.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A 31.5 m ride of at most 15.55 s inside the comfort limits
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: animated shaft with a comfort meter
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a shaft, live graphs and a comfort meter for two profiles; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Car, counterweight and live speed, acceleration and jerk graphs
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
